facts.business: Revati Media Limited operates in the media and entertainment sector, evaluating opportunities in acquisition and exploitation of film rights, content distribution, licensing arrangements, and strategic collaborations.
key_risks: Inadequate availability of capital and limited resources constraining scale and pace of business operations
Global economic uncertainty due to geopolitical tensions, ongoing wars, and macroeconomic factors affecting business conditions and consumer spending
Company incurred losses during the year and financial position remains under pressure
facts.related_party_note: During the financial year, the Company did not enter into any contract or arrangement with related parties which falls within the ambit of Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 requiring disclosure under Section 134(3)(h) of the Act read with Rule 8(2) of the Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014. Accordingly, the disclosure in Form AOC-2 is not applicable to the Company. The related party disclosures as required under Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) 24 – Related Party Disclosures form part of the Notes to the Financial Statements.
